citations.source_publication: John Jamieson, D.D., An Etymological Dictionary of the Scottish Language, Vol. II (Edinburgh: University Press for W. Creech et al., 1808)
citations.page_and_column: Title leaf n4 (1808); Vol. II sig. 4S2v (leaf n372), s.v. SCULDUDRY
citations.verbatim_quote: SCULDUDRY, s.
